input_status.tau_bits: assumed: one id per prompt token and none per generated token, which the round samples; a round is not traced (its decode loop's length is no token axis of the capture)

input_status.w_fit_gates: assumed: the rounds' counted work, each GEMM on the served codes (W4A4, emulated in bf16 on decoded values) priced as NVFP4 (gemm/fp4), per token through the forward: each prompt token and every generated token but the last (the counter counts the prompts' alone)
input_status.alpha_ratio: assumed: a round's affected work is its forward ops that read an update tensor (te_core's untraced convention); a round is not traced (its decode loop's length is no token axis of the capture)
input_status.u_points: assumed: te_core's stub (A1), evenly spread to u(1) = Delta; a round is not traced (its decode loop's length is no token axis of the capture)
input_status.u_in_points: assumed: te_core's stub (A1'), u_in = u; a round is not traced (its decode loop's length is no token axis of the capture)
